data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years. Due to a light incurred claims development on short tail lines the Syndicate has released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property. The Syndicate also experienced light incurred claims development and a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business, resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss GBP 0.4m) respectively.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Released reserves of GBP 2.3m from Property due to light incurred claims development on short tail lines
Release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m
Release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Accident & Health resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 2.3m

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded favourable prior year reserve development in 2014, driven by light incurred claims development on short-tail portfolios. Management reports releases from prior years of GBP 2.3m in Property and further favourable development in Professional Lines (GBP 3.4m) and Accident & Health (GBP 2.3m), representing an aggregate release of approximately GBP 8.0m (around 3.7% of opening gross claims outstanding).
raw_causal_phrases: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years.
light incurred claims development on short tail lines
a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount derived from explicit narrative sentences in the Strategic Report that quantify releases by line (Property GBP 2.3m; Professional Lines GBP 3.4m; Accident & Health GBP 2.3m) and summed to give aggregate PYD of GBP 8.0m (release). No separate 'Movement in prior year's provision' reconciliation table or gross claims development triangle was available to cross-check; amounts assumed to be gross as stated in the narrative.
